query: SELECT ds.id, ds.restaurantId, r.name as restaurantName, rc.name as categoryName FROM daily_settings ds INNER JOIN restaurants r ON ds.restaurantId = r.id INNER JOIN restaurant_categories rc ON r.categoryId = rc.id WHERE DATE(ds.settingDate) = '2026-05-10' AND ds.isActive = 1 ORDER BY rc.sortOrder, r.sortOrder;
